title: Cause and Impact of Power Outage at Woodlands Checkpoint on 9 October 2022
what_it_is: Cause and Impact of Power Outage at Woodlands Checkpoint on 9 October 2022

sections.label: Back-up generator failure outage
sections.summary: During maintenance, the back-up power generator was activated but failed at 12.20 am on 9 October 2022, disrupting checkpoint operations.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As part of the maintenance, the back-up power generator was activated to provide power during this period.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: However, at 12.20 am on 9 October 2022, the back-up power generator failed, resulting in a power outage that disrupted the checkpoint operations.

sections.label: Cause of generator failure
sections.summary: The back-up power generator failed because a fresh tear in the air duct discharged hot air into the room instead of outside.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The cause of the failure of the back-up power generator was a fresh tear in the air duct, causing hot air from the generator to be discharged into the room instead of outside the room.

sections.label: Air duct replacement consideration
sections.summary: ICA will consider periodically replacing the air duct as a precaution, and there was no data breach or loss during the outage.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As a precautionary measure, ICA will consider if the air duct should be replaced periodically in the future, even if no tears are detected.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: There was no data breach or loss during the power outage.

sections.label: Planned power resiliency enhancement
sections.summary: Before the incident, ICA had planned to enhance power resiliency at Woodlands and Tuas Checkpoints by building a secondary electrical infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Prior to this incident, ICA had already planned to further enhance power resiliency at Woodlands and Tuas Checkpoints by building a secondary electrical infrastructure, in addition to the existing one.

sections.label: Traveller manhours lost
sections.summary: If 300,000 travellers a day each take one and a half hours to clear immigration, 450,000 manhours of productive time are lost daily.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If there are 300,000 travellers a day and each takes one and a half hours to clear immigration, that is 450,000 manhours of productive time lost every day.

sections.label: No security breaches
sections.summary: There were no security breaches, such as illegal or unauthorised entry into Singapore, during the power outage incident.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Essentially, there were no security breaches, such as illegal or unauthorised entry into Singapore, during the power outage incident.

sections.label: ICA checkpoint power resiliency
sections.summary: ICA will deploy additional generators for scheduled maintenance and had planned a secondary electrical infrastructure at Woodlands and Tuas Checkpoints by 2028.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We look at issues that affect our security and incidents that may go beyond power outages.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And about the generators, to prevent a recurrence of that incident, ICA will deploy additional generators as further buffers to the existing back-up generators for all subsequent scheduled maintenance work.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And, in fact, prior to this incident, ICA had already planned to enhance the power resiliency at Woodlands and Tuas Checkpoints by building a secondary electrical infrastructure by 2028.
